# harvester_kubeovn_iptables_snat_rule (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# The VMs of the subnet reach external networks with the address of the EIP.
resource "harvester_kubeovn_iptables_snat_rule" "example" {
  name          = "my-snat-rule"
  eip           = harvester_kubeovn_iptables_eip.example.name
  internal_cidr = harvester_kubeovn_subnet.example.cidr_block
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `eip` (String) Name of the iptables EIP whose address replaces the source address of the traffic.
- `internal_cidr` (String) CIDR of the VPC addresses whose outgoing traffic is translated, usually the CIDR of the subnet.
- `name` (String) A unique name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `status_internal_cidr` (String) Internal CIDR applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_nat_gw_dp` (String) NAT gateway the rule is applied in.
- `status_v4_ip` (String) IPv4 address of the EIP applied by kube-ovn.
- `status_v6_ip` (String) IPv6 address of the EIP applied by kube-ovn.
